lines.text: They just [g]wait for their turn to talk.
Here's a manners check that's [g]1,200 years old.
Be honest. How many do you [t]pass?
[g]Two. If someone [t]else gets asked, don't answer for them.
[g]Three. When someone's telling a [t]story, let them tell it.
And don't let them see you [g]already know it.
[g]Five. Learn to [t]listen well, the way you learn to [g]speak well.
